executor_v2_sanity.config: executor@2.0.0-beta.15 stock `executor serve`; not debug log-level
executor_v2_sanity.unit: individual tools/call latency (same as all arms); 3s step window
executor_v2_sanity.errors: 0 on every step of every rep; breaks are p99-only

throughput.note: Rises ~1.6-1.7× from 1→2 clients then plateaus ~50-58; extra clients mostly queue

executor_v2_sanity.page_one_liner: Executor v2's throughput levels off at about 57 tool calls per second from two clients onward, so additional clients mostly add queueing. At a 100 ms p99, it sustains 2 to 3 clients.
executor_v2_sanity.not_stdio_chaos: Do not compare to ~19-23 process-per-client stdio ceiling — different topology.
